newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA UNCHANGED FOR THIRD TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA UNCHANGED FOR THIRD TEST.

text.p: South Africa's selectors took the unprecedented step on Tuesday of naming their X1 significantly early for the third and final test against India later this month.
The team who secured a 2-0 winning lead in the series with a 282-run victory in Cape Town on Monday have been named en bloc for the Johannesburg test starting on January 16.
Northern Transvaal's off-spinning skipper Mark Davis has been called up as 12th man. Northerns are without a match during the test.
Since their return to world cricket with the dismantling of apartheid, South Africa have not named their side until the morning of the match.
Team: Hansie Cronje (captain), Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Daryll Cullinan, Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
